rule: A row is written only when the source states the rate, with its link and date. Since Oct 12, 2026 (Tyler), TCGplayer Authentication Center pull-rate articles are accepted: they are sample-based estimates from the packs they opened, shown with the sample size and 95% interval where the article gives one. Nothing is guessed; a set with no stated rate has no row. Rows from other published sources (Pullnomics, TCGscreener) are kept with their link, date and method; where TCGplayer has a figure for the same set and rarity, TCGplayer is the row and the other source is listed under crossChecks.

merged.note: Published pull rates only, cited. Rates are per tier (any card of the rarity), 1 in N packs.
